description: Observed native Fetch staking FLOW on fetchhub-4 for today or yesterday UTC, using finalized 15-minute buckets and comparable historical periods. Returns exact afet strings, coverage and source cursor. This is NOT total staked balance, a statistical anomaly assessment, or a security verdict. Signature status is explicit in integrity.signed. Errors mean unavailable evidence, never zero flow. Defaults: today, 7 baseline days.
name: fet112.staking_context
title: Native Fetch Staking Flow
